blockingFindings.title: Review action resolver now throws for callers without tree resolver
blockingFindings.issue: resolveReviewActionForFlowState now throws whenever matching convergence records exist and the caller does not pass resolveTreeSha. The diff updates get-status and get-next-action, but this exported helper is still part of the flow review-convergence surface and existing callers/tests that resolve persisted review actions by phase/task without a tree resolver will now crash instead of returning the stored action or null.
blockingFindings.suggestion: Keep resolveReviewActionForFlowState backward-compatible by making tree filtering conditional when resolveTreeSha is supplied, or update every production and test caller in the touched scope and add a regression asserting legacy/no-resolver behavior is either supported or intentionally rejected through a controlled Envelope error.
blockingFindings.rationale: R8 requires affected shared flow regression coverage and unchanged review behavior outside the target policy. Introducing an uncaught exception on the exported resolver is a blocking behavior regression unless all callers are migrated and covered.
